## [CN]背景：液态玻璃上的 PlusButton 替身
## [EN]Background: the plus button's stand-in on Liquid Glass

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 液态玻璃（iOS 26+）选中某个 Tab 时，系统在它上方显示一块玻璃（选中图层，platter）。玻璃下方的内容透过玻璃显示，看起来是模糊、放大的；选中图层中的内容才是清晰的。选中 PlusButton 子控制器时，真正的 PlusButton 位于玻璃下方，因此本库在选中图层中放一个 PlusButton 的替身（`-[CYLPlusButton selectedContentView]`），中心与 PlusButton 重合（`CYLTabBarController.m` 中安装替身的代码，以及 `CYLPlusButton.m` 中跟随 PlusButton 位置的代码）。用户看到的清晰图标就是这个替身。 | When a tab is selected on Liquid Glass (iOS 26+), the system shows a piece of glass over it (the selected layer, the platter). What lies under the glass shows through it blurred and magnified; only what is in the selected layer is sharp. With the plus child view controller selected, the real plus button lies under the glass, so the library puts a stand-in of the plus button (`-[CYLPlusButton selectedContentView]`) into the selected layer, centered on the plus button (the code that installs it in `CYLTabBarController.m`, and the code in `CYLPlusButton.m` that follows the plus button's position). The sharp icon the user sees is that stand-in. |
| 因此“PlusButton 图标模糊”意味着：替身没有显示、位置不对，或者显示的图片与 PlusButton 不同，用户看到的是玻璃下方的 PlusButton。扁平样式与经典样式没有选中图层，也没有替身。 | So "the plus button's icon is blurred" means the stand-in is not shown, is in the wrong place, or shows another image than the plus button: the user sees the plus button under the glass. FlatDesign and the classic style have no selected layer and no stand-in. |

## [CN]测试方法
## [EN]Test method

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 手动测试：点击 PlusButton（或把 TabBar 的 `selectedIndex` 设为 2）切换到 PlusButton 子控制器，观察 PlusButton 的图标是否模糊；然后点击导航栏右上角的“换肤”按钮切换主题，再观察一次。预期换肤前后都不模糊。 | By hand: tap the plus button (or set the tab bar's `selectedIndex` to 2) to show the plus child view controller and look at the plus button's icon; then switch the theme with the "Skin" button at the top right of the navigation bar and look again. It must be sharp both times. |
| 自动测试使用 ObjC Demo 的启动参数（由 `UIViewController+CYLThemeSettings.m` 读取）：`-CYLDemoThemeIdentifier A` 以主题 A 启动；`-CYLDemoSelectIndex 2` 在启动 2 秒后选中第 2 个 Tab，与点击相同；`-CYLDemoThemeSwitchTo B` 切换到主题 B，与点击“换肤”按钮走同一段代码（`CYLDemoApplyTheme`）。各步骤按链式执行，并与脚本握手：每个需要截图的状态之后，App 等待脚本保存截图并在 App 数据容器中创建 `tmp/ack-<步骤>`（最多 30 秒）再继续。步骤：选中（启动 2 秒后）→ “before” 检查 → 截图 → “只看替身” → 截图 → 切换 → “after” 检查（3 秒后）→ 截图 → “只看替身” → 截图 → “done”。原因：CI 上一次截图需要 1 秒到 10 秒以上，按固定延时计时的话，App 会在截图过程中继续执行（“before” 截图已经是新主题，或截到为“只看替身”隐藏的 PlusButton，看起来像星星被截断）。 | The automated test uses launch arguments of the ObjC demo (read by `UIViewController+CYLThemeSettings.m`): `-CYLDemoThemeIdentifier A` launches with theme A; `-CYLDemoSelectIndex 2` selects tab 2 two seconds after launch, as a tap does; `-CYLDemoThemeSwitchTo B` switches to theme B, through the same code as the "Skin" button (`CYLDemoApplyTheme`). The steps run as a chain with a handshake: after each state to photograph, the app waits until the script has saved its screenshot and created `tmp/ack-<step>` in the app's data container (at most 30 seconds), then goes on. Steps: the selection (2 seconds after launch) → the "before" check → screenshot → "stand-in only" → screenshot → the switch → the "after" check (3 seconds later) → screenshot → "stand-in only" → screenshot → "done". The reason: on CI a screenshot took from 1 to more than 10 seconds, and with fixed delays the app moved on during the capture (the "before" screenshot showed the new theme, or caught the plus button hidden for the "stand-in only" step, which looked like a cut-off star). |
| Demo 自己检查两次：选中 3 秒后（“before”）与切换 3 秒后（“after”）。检查内容：替身已经显示在 window 中；替身当前显示的图片（`currentImage`）与 PlusButton 自己的普通、选中或高亮图片之一相同（同一个对象或像素相同）；真实的 PlusButton 在玻璃内被 mask 掉（见下方“可能的错乱”）。之后还会输出 info 行（替身与 PlusButton 的 frame、可见性、图片视图实际显示的图片、裁剪替身的视图），并在截图后隐藏真实 PlusButton，脚本据此截一张“只看替身”的图（`…-stand-in-only.png`）。结果输出为一行日志：`plus child theme test: PASS|FAIL|SKIP <before/after> theme=… selectedIndex=… standIn=<尺寸> plusButton=<尺寸>`，最后输出 `plus child theme test: done`。不在液态玻璃 TabBar 中（液态玻璃未处于活动状态，或使用扁平样式；iOS 26 上使用扁平样式时 `+isLiquidGlassActive` 也为 YES）时输出 SKIP。 | The demo checks twice: 3 seconds after the selection ("before") and 3 seconds after the switch ("after"). It checks that the stand-in is in a window, that the image it shows (`currentImage`) is one of the plus button's own normal, selected or highlighted images (the same object or the same pixels), and that the real plus button is masked out under the glass (see "Possible glitches" below). It then logs info lines (the frames of the stand-in and the plus button, visibility, the image the image view really draws, the view that clips the stand-in) and after the screenshot hides the real plus button, for a "stand-in only" screenshot (`…-stand-in-only.png`). The result is one log line, `plus child theme test: PASS|FAIL|SKIP <before/after> theme=… selectedIndex=… standIn=<size> plusButton=<size>`, followed by `plus child theme test: done`. Outside a Liquid Glass tab bar (Liquid Glass not active, or the FlatDesign style; on iOS 26 `+isLiquidGlassActive` is YES with FlatDesign too) it logs SKIP. |
| 脚本 `scripts/plus-child-theme-test.sh` 编译 Demo，在 iOS 模拟器上为每个场景启动一次（App 把每行测试输出立即追加到其数据容器中的 `tmp/plus-child-theme-test.log`，脚本通过 `xcrun simctl get_app_container … data` 读取；`simctl launch --console-pty` 的控制台输出直到 App 关闭才传到脚本，不能用来决定截图时机），并在 App 输出 before 与 after 检查行之后立即各截一张图，保存在 `build/plus-child-theme-test/`（启动可能需要数秒，从启动命令开始计算的固定延时曾截到主屏幕或切换前的主题）。出现 FAIL、App 没有输出 `done`（例如崩溃），或设置 `REQUIRE_PASS=1` 而没有任何 PASS 时，脚本失败。 | The script `scripts/plus-child-theme-test.sh` builds the demo, launches it once per scenario on an iOS simulator (the app appends every test line at once to `tmp/plus-child-theme-test.log` in its data container, which the script reads through `xcrun simctl get_app_container … data`; the console stream of `simctl launch --console-pty` reached the script only when the app was closed, so it cannot time the screenshots), and saves a screenshot right after the app logs its before and after checks, in `build/plus-child-theme-test/` (a launch can take seconds: fixed delays from the launch command caught the home screen, or the theme before the switch). It fails on any FAIL, when the app never logs `done` (e.g. a crash), and, with `REQUIRE_PASS=1`, when nothing passed. |

```sh
# Liquid Glass (iOS 26 simulator); the check must pass
REQUIRE_PASS=1 scripts/plus-child-theme-test.sh
# FlatDesign: no stand-in (SKIP), screenshots only
STYLE=FlatDesign scripts/plus-child-theme-test.sh
# Other scenarios / another tab
SCENARIOS="Halloween>Dark,Dark>Default" SELECT_INDEX=2 scripts/plus-child-theme-test.sh
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| CI：workflow “Plus child theme test” 在修改 PlusButton、`CYLTabBarController.m`、主题代码、Demo 主题、脚本或 workflow 的 PR 上运行，也可以手动运行（可输入场景）。液态玻璃 job 设置 `REQUIRE_PASS=1`；扁平样式 job 只提供截图。截图与日志是本次运行的 artifact（`plus-child-theme-test-Default`、`plus-child-theme-test-FlatDesign`）。截图也用于人工复查：放大 PlusButton 区域，比较切换前后。 | CI: the "Plus child theme test" workflow runs on pull requests that change the plus button, `CYLTabBarController.m`, the theme code, the demo themes, the script or the workflow, and by hand (with optional scenarios). The Liquid Glass job sets `REQUIRE_PASS=1`; the FlatDesign job only adds screenshots. The screenshots and logs are artifacts of the run (`plus-child-theme-test-Default`, `plus-child-theme-test-FlatDesign`). The screenshots are for a human check too: zoom into the plus button and compare before and after. |

## [CN]测试场景
## [EN]Test scenarios

| 场景 / Scenario | 切换前 / Before | 切换后 / After | 覆盖的情况 / What it covers |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `Default>Christmas` | 默认主题，PlusButton 为 App 自己的 “+” / Default theme, the app's own "+" | 圣诞节皮肤，PlusButton 为星星图标 / Christmas skin, a star on the plus button | 替身已存在时运行时换肤 / a runtime switch while the stand-in exists |
| `Christmas>Pink Rose` | 圣诞节皮肤（启动时应用，早于第一次选中 PlusButton 子控制器） / Christmas, applied at launch, before the plus child is first selected | 玫瑰粉：配色主题，PlusButton 恢复 “+” / Pink Rose, a color theme: the plus button gets its "+" back | 启动时已有主题再创建替身（本测试发现的 bug），以及恢复原图 / a stand-in made after a theme (the bug this test found), and restoring the original image |
| `Spring Festival>Network` | 春节皮肤 / Spring Festival | 网络皮肤：PlusButton 图片从网络下载并缩放 / Network skin: the plus button's images are downloaded and resized | 异步加载、缩放后的图片 / images loaded asynchronously and resized |

## [CN]预期效果
## [EN]Expected results

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 液态玻璃：每个场景的 before 与 after 都输出 PASS；截图中 PlusButton 的图标完整、清晰，是当前主题的图标（星星、“+” 或网络图标），玻璃外没有露出另一张图片的边缘。 | Liquid Glass: every scenario logs PASS for before and after; in the screenshots the plus button's icon is whole and sharp and is the current theme's (a star, "+" or the network icon), with no edge of another image showing around the glass. |
| 扁平样式：日志为 SKIP（没有替身）；截图中 PlusButton 在切换前后都显示当前主题的图标，并且清晰。 | FlatDesign: the log says SKIP (no stand-in); in the screenshots the plus button shows the current theme's icon, sharp, before and after. |
| 所有样式：其他 Tab（包括 PlusButton 后面的 Tab）保持自己的图标与标题，第一个 Tab 的封面与角标仍在（见 [Theme-Switching.md](Theme-Switching.md)）。 | Every style: the other tabs (also the ones after the plus button) keep their own icons and titles, and the first tab's cover and badges stay (see [Theme-Switching.md](Theme-Switching.md)). |

## [CN]可能的错乱与推测原因
## [EN]Possible glitches and their likely causes

| 现象 / Glitch | 推测原因 / Likely cause | 状态 / Status |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 选中 PlusButton 子控制器后，玻璃内显示 “+”，玻璃外露出主题图标（例如星星）的一部分，图标看起来模糊、被截断；切换主题后恢复正常 / With the plus child selected, the glass shows "+" while part of the theme's icon (e.g. the star) shows outside it, so the icon looks blurred and cut; it is fine after a theme switch | 替身在第一次选中 PlusButton 子控制器时才由子类的 `+plusButton` 新建，带的是 App 原来的图片；在此之前应用的主题（例如启动时恢复的主题）没有更新它。之后的换肤会通过 `-cyl_updateTitle:image:selectedImage:` 更新已存在的替身，所以切换后正常 / The stand-in is made by the subclass's `+plusButton` the first time the plus child is selected, with the app's original images; a theme applied before that (e.g. the one restored at launch) never reached it. Later switches update the existing stand-in through `-cyl_updateTitle:image:selectedImage:`, hence fine after a switch | 已修复：PlusButton 记住最近一次更新的图片，新建替身时使用（`CYLPlusButton.m`，仅在液态玻璃 TabBar 中：液态玻璃处于活动状态且不是扁平样式，与 master 的判断相同）/ Fixed: the plus button keeps the images it was last given and the new stand-in gets them (`CYLPlusButton.m`, only in a Liquid Glass tab bar: Liquid Glass active and not the FlatDesign style, as master checks it) |
| 选中 PlusButton 子控制器后，主题图标（例如星星）在玻璃内发虚、边缘有一圈模糊的光晕，玻璃外的部分清晰；App 自己的 “+” 图标正常 / With the plus child selected, a theme icon (e.g. the star) is soft inside the glass, with a blurred halo around its edges, and sharp outside the glass; the app's own "+" is fine | 替身本身是清晰的（“只看替身”截图：隐藏真实 PlusButton 后星星清晰）。玻璃会把下方的真实 PlusButton 模糊并放大后显示出来：App 的 “+” 是不透明的圆盘，正好挡住这个模糊副本；星星有透明区域，模糊副本从边缘露出来。只比较图片对象的检查无法发现这一点 / The stand-in itself is sharp (the "stand-in only" screenshot: with the real plus button hidden, the star is sharp). The glass shows the real plus button under it blurred and magnified: the app's "+" is an opaque disc that covers that blurred copy, while the star has transparent parts and the copy shows around its edges. A check that only compares image objects cannot see this | 已修复：显示替身时，真实 PlusButton 在 PlusButton Tab 上方的玻璃内被 mask 掉（选中图层中容纳替身的 Tab 按钮，胶囊形；第一次实现 mask 掉了整个 TabBar platter，platter 顶部与玻璃之间出现一条空隙）（`-[CYLPlusButton cyl_updateLiquidGlassMask]`，仅液态玻璃 TabBar、仅选中 PlusButton 子控制器时）；检查要求该 mask 存在（`realButtonMaskedUnderGlass=1`），并输出裁剪替身的视图 / Fixed: while the stand-in is shown, the real plus button is masked out inside the glass over the plus tab (the selected-layer tab button that holds the stand-in, a capsule; a first version masked the whole tab bar platter and left a strip between the platter's top and the glass) (`-[CYLPlusButton cyl_updateLiquidGlassMask]`, only in a Liquid Glass tab bar and only with the plus child selected); the check requires that mask (`realButtonMaskedUnderGlass=1`) and logs the view that clips the stand-in |
| 整个 PlusButton 都模糊，玻璃内没有清晰的图标 / The whole plus button is blurred, nothing sharp in the glass | 替身没有安装到选中图层：选中图层控件（`cyl_platterSelectedControl`）尚未创建，或 UIKit 重建了 Tab 按钮而替身留在旧按钮中 / The stand-in is not in the selected layer: the selected-layer control (`cyl_platterSelectedControl`) did not exist yet, or UIKit rebuilt the tab buttons and the stand-in stayed in an old one | 检查会输出 FAIL “the stand-in is not shown”；`CYLTabBarController.m` 中安装替身的代码会重试 / The check logs FAIL "the stand-in is not shown"; the installing code in `CYLTabBarController.m` retries |
| 替身清晰但偏离 PlusButton，出现两个图标 / A sharp stand-in beside the plus button: two icons | 替身中心没有跟随 PlusButton（例如 PlusButton 因标题变长而变宽后）/ The stand-in's center did not follow the plus button (e.g. after a longer title widened it) | 截图人工检查；位置由 `CYLPlusButton.m` 的坐标转换维护 / Checked by eye in the screenshots; the position is kept by the coordinate conversion in `CYLPlusButton.m` |
| 图标边缘发虚（像素化），而不是透过玻璃的模糊 / A pixelated icon rather than the blur of the glass | 图片以错误的 scale 缩放：网络图片没有提供尺寸时按图片视图的尺寸缩放；`CYLImageScaledToSize` 使用屏幕 scale 绘制 / An image resized at the wrong scale: a network image without a size is resized to the image view's size; `CYLImageScaledToSize` draws at the screen's scale | 场景 `Spring Festival>Network` 覆盖；目前未发现 / Covered by `Spring Festival>Network`; not seen so far |
| PlusButton 后面的 Tab 图标或标题消失、Tab 内容错位 / A tab after the plus button loses its icon or title, tabs shifted | `tabBarItemsAttributes` 中 PlusButton 的 slot 项被当作某个 Tab 的属性 / The plus button's slot entry in `tabBarItemsAttributes` was taken for a tab's attributes | 已修复（[#780](https://github.com/ChenYilong/CYLTabBarController/pull/780)，以及主题代码使用 `-cyl_isPlusSlotViewController:`）/ Fixed ([#780](https://github.com/ChenYilong/CYLTabBarController/pull/780), and the theme code uses `-cyl_isPlusSlotViewController:`) |
| 换肤后第一个 Tab 的封面或角标消失 / The first tab's cover or badges are gone after a switch | 只执行一次的布局 block（`-setViewDidLayoutSubViewsBlockInvokeOnce:block:`）被永久标记为已执行 / The one-time layout block (`-setViewDidLayoutSubViewsBlockInvokeOnce:block:`) stayed marked as run | 已修复：换肤、重新加载 Tab 与替换 Tab 后再执行一次 / Fixed: it runs once more after a theme switch, a tab reload and a tab replacement |
| 截图与主题不符：以 `Default` 启动的场景切换前的截图已经是切换后的主题，或切换后的截图仍是切换前的主题，或截到主屏幕 / A screenshot that does not match the theme: the "before" screenshot of a scenario launched with `Default` already showed the theme switched to, an "after" screenshot still showed the old theme, or the home screen | 截图时机问题，不是 App 的问题：日志中 `launch theme=Default` 与 before 行的 `theme=Default` 说明主题正确；截图原来按启动命令后的固定延时截取，而 App 启动可能需要数秒；之后改为等待控制台输出，但 `--console-pty` 的输出直到 App 关闭才到达，截图仍在最后才截取 / A screenshot timing problem, not the app: the log's `launch theme=Default` and the before line's `theme=Default` show the right theme; the screenshots were taken at fixed delays after the launch command, and the app can take seconds to start; waiting for the console output instead did not help, because `--console-pty` delivered it only when the app was closed, so the screenshots were still taken at the end | 已修复：App 把测试输出立即写入数据容器中的文件，每张截图在该文件出现对应检查行之后立即截取 / Fixed: the app writes its test lines at once to a file in its data container, and each screenshot is taken right after that check appears there |

## [CN]限制
## [EN]Limits

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| CI 无法点击屏幕：选中 Tab 用 `selectedIndex`，换肤用与“换肤”按钮相同的函数，但没有经过按钮的点击与菜单。 | CI cannot tap: the tab is selected with `selectedIndex` and the theme is switched with the same function as the "Skin" button, without the button's tap and menu. |
| 自动检查只比较替身显示的图片是否属于 PlusButton；位置、尺寸与清晰度由截图人工判断。 | The automated check only compares the stand-in's image with the plus button's; position, size and sharpness are judged by eye in the screenshots. |
| 本文写作时，测试在 CI 的 iOS 26 模拟器上运行；没有在真机上运行。 | At the time of writing, the test ran on CI's iOS 26 simulator, not on a device. |
